# ADR 0001: One deployable Spring Boot service (modular monolith) on PostgreSQL

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Settlement reconciliation engine

## Context

Settlement reconciliation engine has a handful of closely related capabilities, one team (you) and Phase 1 skills. Microservices add network failure modes, distributed transactions and operational cost without a matching benefit at this size.

## Decision

Build one Spring Boot 4 service, packaged by feature (one package per capability), with one PostgreSQL database owned by the service. Keep module boundaries clean so a module could be extracted later.

## Consequences

Simple deployment, local ACID transactions, fast tests with Testcontainers. Scaling is vertical or by adding stateless instances behind the load balancer; independent scaling of one capability is not possible yet.

## Alternatives considered

Microservices per capability (revisit in Phase 3, Module 10); serverless functions (cold starts and transaction boundaries are awkward for this workload).
